messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.3.1

1.3.1. Risk of loss of stability The machinery or related product and its components and fittings shall be stable enough to avoid overturning, falling or uncontrolled movements during transportation, assembly, dismantling and any other action involving the machinery or related product. If the shape of the machinery or related product itself or its intended installation does not offer sufficient stability, appropriate means of anchorage shall be incorporated and indicated in the instructions for use.

response.text:
Machinery or related product and its components and fittings | shall be stable enough | to avoid overturning, falling or uncontrolled movements | during transportation, assembly, dismantling and any other action involving the machinery or related product | "shall be stable enough to avoid overturning, falling or uncontrolled movements during transportation, assembly, dismantling and any other action involving the machinery or related product"
Machinery or related product | shall incorporate | appropriate means of anchorage | if its own shape or its intended installation does not offer sufficient stability | "If the shape of the machinery or related product itself or its intended installation does not offer sufficient stability, appropriate means of anchorage shall be incorporated"
Means of anchorage | shall be indicated | in the instructions for use | where anchorage means are incorporated for stability | "appropriate means of anchorage shall be incorporated and indicated in the instructions for use"
